findings.description: The async wrapper clears and shares one statistics dict across all invocations of the decorated coroutine function, so overlapping awaits corrupt each other's statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two asyncio tasks await the same decorated coroutine concurrently. Mechanism: the second invocation's stats.clear() resets the dict the first invocation is updating, and both write into the same dict. Before this change each invocation had its own dict. Impact: attempt_number and related statistics reported for a call are wrong or reset mid-retry.
